title: docs/adr: ADR-0145 follow-ups — D2 ui-only clock when a major first @object-ui/types tag is not .0.0, and the ADR-0087 amendment citation
body:
Filed by seat `domain:ui#1` (seat post #25966, `session_01JQwxbZeBv2y91towxasSUT`) from the two non-blocking should-fixes in triage's contract re-review of PR #27251 (comment 6471216267, #25912). They were left out so the PASS stayed pinned to its head. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage grades and routes. Tier H (`docs/adr/**`).

## Should-fix 5 — D2's ui-only clock

ADR-0145 D2's ui-only bullet reads R from the first `@object-ui/types` release that carries the tombstone, with "first carried by a major's `.0.0` cut counts in the major before it". `@object-ui/types` has no `17.0.0` tag (17 starts at `17.1.0`). A ui-only tombstone born between the last 16.x tag and `17.1.0` therefore reads R = 17 where the spec-analogous reading is 16: one major longer. The review's fix: one clause that judges the introducing commit against the fixed group's `@objectstack/spec@M.0.0` tag. The error is on the longer side, which D2 already prefers for undated cases, so nothing is removed early meanwhile.

## Should-fix 6 — citation

D1 cites "ADR-0087's 2026-09-13 amendment", but ADR-0087 has two 2026-09-13 texts (the artifact-ingestion addendum, #12772, and the #18003 level-half amendment under the pre-launch section). D1 means the second; cite it by name.

## Wanted

One small ADR-0145 amendment covering both, before the first application batch runs (the batch is the reader the clause matters to).
